interface.name: hl_surface_manager_v1
interface.description: Creates an identity capability for a wl_surface. The capability is scoped to this compositor connection and surface lifetime.

interface.name: hl_surface_identity_v1

description.summary: opaque surface identity and commit association

interface.description: Carries an opaque nonzero capability. Clients must not interpret it. associate binds an increasing application frame serial to the next wl_surface.commit. Multiple identity resources for one live wl_surface receive the same capability. Destroying any one of them revokes that capability and retires every sibling identity; a later get_surface creates a fresh capability.

entry.name: invalid_serial
entry.summary: serial is zero or not increasing

entry.name: retired
entry.summary: the identity is no longer live
